changes: Improved the overall app experience with UI polish and bug fixes
Tags: create colored tags to organize snips across folders, filter by tag from the sidebar, and manage tags directly from the editor
Multi-select Actions: select multiple snips at once to quickly move, tag, delete, or drag them together into folders, tags, sections, or Trash
Sections: organize folders into collapsible sections and easily reorder, rename, or manage them from the Section Organizer
Drag & Drop Improvements: drag snips directly onto folders, sections, or tags for faster organization
Folder View: selecting a folder now shows only its direct snips — snips in subfolders stay in their own folder, and count badges reflect this too
Import & Export: export full workspace snapshots with tags, sections, and starred items preserved, then preview imports before restoring or merging content
Starred Snips: star important snips and instantly filter between starred and non-starred content
More Sorting Options: sort snips by modified date, created date, alphabetical order, or most copied
New Floating Toolbar: the toolbar is now detached from the navbar for a cleaner layout and can be moved to any side of the content area

New keyboard shortcuts on snip cards: press E to edit, C to copy, and D to delete
